title: Capital Gains, Homestead & Tax Realities When Selling in Texas
excerpt: Primary residences often qualify for the federal capital-gains exclusion ($250k single / $500k married) if ownership and use tests are met.
body:
People searching Austin-area real estate for “capital gains tax selling house Texas”, “homestead exemption when selling Austin”, and “do I pay taxes on home sale Texas” want a local, practical answer.

Primary residences often qualify for the federal capital-gains exclusion ($250k single / $500k married) if ownership and use tests are met. Texas has no state income tax, which simplifies the picture relative to many other states.

Depreciation recapture can apply on investment properties.

Homestead status and any agricultural exemptions affect the tax bill in the year of sale.

Consult a tax professional early—especially on high-appreciation properties or those with prior rental use.
